title: Value A/B task spec
description: One recurrence-prone coding task: a bug/decision was previously captured as a memory, and a later task touches the same file/subsystem. The experiment runs this task with (treatment) and without (control) that memory injected, and measures whether the captured bug recurs.

repo.description: Git URL or local path. Defaults to the claude-mem-lite repo root.

startCommit.description: SHA to check out the sandbox at — the state BEFORE the captured bug was fixed.

project.description: Project key the captured memory belongs to (must match how the host session infers it, so recall fires).

files.description: Files the captured memory attaches to (drives PreToolUse recall).

capturedMemory.description: The memory a prior session would have saved. Seeded into the treatment arm's DB via the production saveObservation pipeline.

regressionCheck.description: Shell command run in the sandbox AFTER the task. MUST exit 0 when the captured bug is ABSENT; non-zero exit means it recurred.

stale.description: True if capturedMemory references now-deleted/renamed code — used for the staleness probe (does stale injection waste turns?).
